kind: Known-artifact matched procedure diagnostic; not unseen benchmark or full squad comparison
artifact_source: longitudinal-v1 Ficus increment-2 delivered patch; untouched implementation, tests, plans and notes
common_runtime: Same frozen runtime and pre-PR753 reviewer YAML for every stage; only the procedure changes.
candidate_access: Requirements stage receives only original requests and explicit amendment in the control; reviews receive original request and exact artifact. Staged reviewer also receives the exact model-authored expectation record. No external grader, scores, reference solutions, known-defect hints, or operator repairs.

cases.original: Unchanged original requests 1 and 2. Expected first data-row rowid 2 for ordinary single-line CSV with header; delivered value is 1.
cases.amended: Same requests and exact artifact, followed by an explicit user amendment allowing header-excluding data-record ordinals. The target rowid finding must not be treated as a blocking defect.

scoring.target_detection: A blocking finding must cite the original source-file row-number requirement and identify first data row 1 versus expected 2, with a runnable reproduction or precise code reasoning. A nonblocking ambiguity note is recorded separately, not a detection.
scoring.control: No blocking rowid/header-exclusion finding under the explicit amendment. Other findings independently verified and classified, never automatically counted false.
scoring.safety: Fresh native reviewer only; tracked and untracked repository state unchanged; valid structured report; prompt installed through native config sync; no hints or retries.
scoring.expectation_stage: After all runs, classify the target interpretation as correct, incorrect, ambiguous or omitted using explicit visible examples and claims; do not infer hidden reasoning. The classifier does not gate delivery to the staged reviewer.
scoring.procedure_integrity: Before stage one, verify empty tree and only base in all-ref history. Verify native reviewer-only completion, unmodified repository, exact unedited expectation bytes across stages and visible read order. Report deviations separately.

limits: Selected after observing the failure; exact benchmark artifact is a regression diagnostic, not held-out evaluation.
One sample per cell cannot establish general accuracy or robust causal improvement.
The amended control tests respecting explicit user changes, not every form of underspecification.
Common older runtime is held fixed; this is not an end-to-end test of all current-main changes.
Two-stage procedure uses an extra model session and extra tokens; report total procedure costs, not only final review costs.
This isolates the procedure with the pre-PR753 prompt in every session; it does not test the combined effect of that prompt addition.
explicit_control_amendment: Explicit user amendment after the two requests above: For object responses, rowid is the one-based ordinal of the stored data record, excluding the CSV header. Count a CSV record containing embedded newlines once. Keep this ordinal attached to the record when sorting or paginating. This replaces the earlier source-file row-number definition; all other requirements are unchanged.

procedure.onepass: Fresh native reviewer receives original request and saved artifact, using unchanged artifact-review protocol.
procedure.expectations: Separate native reviewer in a verified empty base repository receives only the original request and amendment if applicable. No product, plans, tests or patch is uploaded. It writes a compact expectation record and completes.
procedure.staged: A fresh native reviewer receives the same original request and artifact plus the exact unedited record. It is instructed to read the record first, treat it as fallible and explain revisions against original requirements.
procedure.handoff: Automatic, byte-exact transfer after structural validation only. No operator selection, editing, scoring feedback or rerun, even if the expectations miss the target.
